svg.aria-label: Pointmap reconstruction error (AbsRel) for Atlas, Pi3X (posed), π³, VGGT-Ω 1B, Depth Anything 3, MapAnything on their average, then DTU, ETH3D, KITTI, NRGBD, 7-Scenes, Tanks and Temples, and ScanNet. Lower is better; Atlas has the lowest average error at 25.3 thousandths. Starts on the average; swipe right to zoom out to every benchmark.
svg.desc: Mean absolute-relative pointmap error per dataset for Atlas and five recent baselines; lower is better.
